scope_zh: 保留原 26 类官能团标签、SMARTS、优先级、结构和 split。本文件只定义问答模板，不重打标签、不删除分子，也不是全库三维图对应验收。

record_selection.eligibility_note_zh: 上述是字段适用数量，不是承诺最终每个任务均生成该数量，更不代表新增全量 XYZ 键级核验。

message_contract.selection: Select a query and a compatible response only within the same task and any required label subgroup.
message_contract.balance: Balance template usage within split, task and response-label subgroup. This does not imply resampling aromatic positive and negative records to equal counts.
message_contract.expansion: Use the explicit corpus_recipe quotas. Do not emit the Cartesian product of wordings or description schemes.
message_contract.excluded_target_policy: Do not emit excluded properties in dedicated questions or factual descriptions, including values derived from other fields. Preserve the original source values outside the generated conversation.
message_contract.selfies_target_exception: The explicitly requested molecular representation is permitted as an assistant target. It is not an input geometry placeholder.
message_contract.modality_rule: Select exactly one input mode per example. Spectrum inputs may contain a declared, verified combination of spectrum types. Do not require both spectra and 3D structure.
message_contract.query_rule: Every user message starts with a truthful input preamble selected by the actual input mode, followed by one existing task query. Spectrum preambles name exactly the one to eight spectrum types actually supplied. The task query itself remains modality-neutral.
message_contract.no_target_leakage: Feed only the selected input payload and query to the model. Record identifiers, molecular strings, scalar labels, other answers and source properties must not be included in the input payload.

user_prompt_composition.spectrum_type_source: input_spectrum_refs[*].spectrum_type after selecting and validating the actual input payload
user_prompt_composition.spectrum_name_join: One name unchanged. Two names joined by and. Three to eight names joined by commas and a final comma followed by and.
user_prompt_composition.payload_order_rule: Arrange the selected spectrum references and payloads in spectrum_type_order, and list the same ordered types in the preamble. Do not reorder only the names while leaving unlabelled payloads in another order.
validation_rules: Use the actual selected payload, not all source types available for a record, to choose the preamble.
Spectrum mode requires one to eight distinct known spectrum types, with one reference per type.
Every selected spectrum must correspond to the same authority record and target molecule.
Reject empty selections, duplicate types, unknown types and references from another record.
Structure mode requires its own matched structure reference and must not claim spectra were supplied.
Every rendered user message has exactly one preamble and one task query, with no unfilled slots.
Preambles describe the provided modality only, not target properties, stereochemistry, experimental provenance or uniqueness of inverse identification.
user_prompt_composition.sampling_rule: Select spectrum subsets using subset_sampling, then choose one compatible preamble wording and one task-query wording. Do not create fixed complete versus partial views, and do not expand all spectrum subsets or every wording combination into training records.

subset_sampling.allocation_scope: Across spectral examples within each original split and enabled task, not separately within each molecule.
subset_sampling.count_allocation: Allocate spectrum-count quotas by the listed percentages using largest-remainder rounding, with deterministic ties in ascending spectrum-count order.
subset_sampling.within_count_selection: Uniformly choose distinct types among the current molecule's audited nonempty finite nonzero traces. Allocate cardinalities globally within split and task, subject to availability and no repeated subset.
subset_sampling.duplicate_handling: Avoid repeating the same spectrum subset for the same record and task. Retry within the planned count quota; if infeasible, report the unmet quota rather than silently changing the distribution.
subset_sampling.view_partition: No mandatory main, full-input, single-spectrum or missing-modality view per record.
subset_sampling.reporting: Report target and realized counts by split, task, spectrum count and spectrum type, together with failed input bindings and unfilled quotas.
subset_sampling.readiness: Generation requires spectrum_index.jsonl and spectrum_audit_report.json; empty channels are excluded, never zero-filled.

calculation_provenance.evidence: Existing raw properties.json declarations, not a new DFT calculation or independent log audit.

functional_group_policy.response_scope: Positive non-exhaustive structural features. All original class names remain in metadata; broad SMARTS classes use literal motif wording in prose.

alkene.negative_caution: A zero label does not exclude every carbon–carbon double bond, including bonds at allene centers.

cyclopropane.positive_motif_phrase: a three-membered carbon ring with only single bonds around the ring

alcohol.positive_motif_phrase: an O–H group attached to a nonaromatic carbon atom
alcohol.reason: The carbon is not required to be saturated. The descriptive phrase avoids excluding enolic matches.
alcohol.rendering_policy: Use the stated structural motif wording rather than an unsupported narrower class name.

aldehyde.positive_motif_phrase: a carbonyl carbon bearing one hydrogen
aldehyde.reason: The other substituent is not constrained. The motif also matches formic acid.
aldehyde.rendering_policy: Use the stated structural motif wording rather than an unsupported narrower class name.

ester.positive_motif_phrase: a C(=O)–O–C linkage ending at a four-connected carbon atom

ether.positive_motif_phrase: a C–O–C linkage through a two-connected oxygen atom
ether.negative_caution: The rule excludes aromatic carbon and precedence can suppress oxygen linkages within more specific groups.

amine.positive_motif_phrase: a nonaromatic nitrogen atom connected to three atoms, counting attached hydrogens
amine.reason: The matching rule does not require carbon substituents or all nitrogen bonds to be single. Specific-group precedence narrows some but not every non-amine match.
amine.rendering_policy: Use the stated structural motif wording rather than an unsupported narrower class name.

azo.positive_motif_phrase: an N=N linkage between two-connected nitrogen atoms

carbamate.positive_motif_phrase: an O–C(=O)–N unit with two-connected oxygen and three-connected nitrogen
carbamate.reason: The singly bonded oxygen need not have an organic substituent, so the motif includes carbamic acid forms.
carbamate.rendering_policy: Use the stated structural motif wording rather than an unsupported narrower class name.

enamine.positive_motif_phrase: an N–C=C unit with three-connected nitrogen

imine.positive_motif_phrase: a C=N bond to a two-connected nitrogen atom

nitro.positive_motif_phrase: an N(=O)–O unit with three-connected nitrogen
nitro.reason: The third nitrogen substituent and the singly bonded oxygen environment are not constrained. Do not assert a carbon-bound nitro group from this rule alone.
nitro.rendering_policy: Use the stated structural motif wording rather than an unsupported narrower class name.

urea.positive_motif_phrase: a urea N–C(=O)–N unit in which both nitrogens carry one hydrogen
urea.negative_caution: A zero label does not exclude urea units with different nitrogen hydrogen counts.

sulfide.positive_motif_phrase: a sulfur atom connected to two atoms, counting attached hydrogens
sulfide.reason: Do not translate this label to thioether or require a C–S–C group. The raw rule also matches thiol sulfur, among other environments.
sulfide.rendering_policy: Use the stated structural motif wording rather than an unsupported narrower class name.

sulfonamide.positive_motif_phrase: an S(=O)2–N unit with four-connected sulfur and three-connected nitrogen

sulfone.positive_motif_phrase: a four-connected sulfur atom bearing two S=O bonds
sulfone.reason: The other sulfur substituents need not be carbon atoms. Do not silently require a carbon-bound sulfone.
sulfone.rendering_policy: Use the stated structural motif wording rather than an unsupported narrower class name.

sulfoxide.positive_motif_phrase: an S=O bond between three-connected sulfur and terminal oxygen
sulfoxide.reason: The other sulfur substituents need not be carbon atoms. Do not silently require a carbon-bound sulfoxide.
sulfoxide.rendering_policy: Use the stated structural motif wording rather than an unsupported narrower class name.

thioester.positive_motif_phrase: a C(=O)–S linkage through a two-connected sulfur atom
thioester.reason: The sulfur substituent is not required to be carbon, so the motif also matches C(=O)SH.
thioester.rendering_policy: Use the stated structural motif wording rather than an unsupported narrower class name.

thiol.positive_motif_phrase: an S–H group on a two-connected sulfur atom
thiol.reason: The non-hydrogen sulfur neighbor is not required to be carbon.
thiol.rendering_policy: Use the stated structural motif wording rather than an unsupported narrower class name.

composition_policy.eligibility: Choose only schemes whose fields are present and finite. Schemes with functional_groups require at least one original positive label.
composition_policy.sampling_rule: Balance scheme and wording usage within each existing split and eligible subgroup, without duplicating every record across all schemes.
composition_policy.assembly_rule: Choose one wording per included module, join complete sentences with single spaces, then fill the description slot.
composition_policy.ordering_rule: Use the module order in the selected scheme. HOMO precedes LUMO when both are included.
composition_policy.duplicate_rule: Include each property at most once. Do not append modules beyond the selected scheme.
composition_policy.aromatic_rule: Use positive or negative module sentences according to corrected aromatic, never aromatic_phase2_label.
composition_policy.functional_group_rule: Use the same positive labels and wording policy as the dedicated motif task.
composition_policy.numeric_rule: Format the stored values. Do not recalculate properties from rounded displayed text.
composition_policy.selfies_rule: Keep the molecular representation as a dedicated output task. Do not append SELFIES to broad factual descriptions.
composition_policy.modality_rule: In spectra mode, choose only schemes explicitly allowing spectra and containing only formula, aromatic and functional_groups modules. In structure_3d mode, every listed eligible scheme is allowed.
composition_policy.fg_empty_rule: For spectra with no original positive functional-group labels, select formula_and_aromaticity. Do not generate an absence claim about functional groups.

verification_scope.source_fields: Existing full-authority SMILES-based FG and corrected aromatic checks matched metadata.
verification_scope.limitation_zh: 抽样不能保证全库三维键图均已独立恢复。138629 是自动键级恢复未解决，不据此判定原标签错误或删除数据。模板验收只确认措辞、字段、单位、条件分支与回填兼容性。

structure_3d.payload: Existing exported Cartesian coordinates and elements
structure_3d.readiness: Exported coordinates verified against source; previous graph-binding audit is sampled, not full-library certification.

spectra.payload: Numerical spectrum data with the modality and axis/unit metadata required to interpret it
spectra.join_rule: Use record_index to obtain key_id from metadata; official parquet SHA256(key) must equal key_id.
required_checks: same record and key_id as target
explicit handling of inapplicable element-specific channels
spectra.split_rule: Use the authority Phase2 split map for all examples. Official train/test filenames are source locations, not the output split.
spectra.readiness: Generation uses the full official trace audit and per-record spectrum index. Missing or empty element-specific channels are not selectable.
spectra.inverse_target_note: A paired SELFIES target is a supervised target, not a claim that every individual spectrum uniquely determines molecular connectivity or stereochemistry.

additional_local_axis_evidence.scope: Prior local sampled kernel alignment, not per-record official metadata
Prior local sampled kernel alignment, not per-record official metadata

selfies_policy.template_scope: All targets retain the existing nonisomeric policy. Six questions use unqualified SELFIES wording and two explicitly omit stereochemistry. The wording choice does not change the target. Do not claim chiral or E/Z recovery from these targets.

validation.scope: SELFIES decoded and compared with authority nonisomeric SMILES; not a full spectrum or XYZ inverse-reconstruction audit.

corpus_recipe.record_unit: Authority record_index, not a claim that all records have distinct nonisomeric connectivity.
corpus_recipe.selection_policy: Preserve original split. Formula and FG each use the same selected half-record set in both modes. Select FG only among nonempty positive-label records. Four scalar tasks partition all records, one scalar task per record. SELFIES uses all records once for structure and twice with distinct spectral subsets. Auxiliary selections preserve split proportions by largest-remainder rounding.
corpus_recipe.template_balance: Independently shuffled wording decks within split, task, input mode and applicable label subgroup. Preambles also stratified by single versus multiple spectra. No repeated fixed query-response pairing.
corpus_recipe.physical_axis_policy: Original parquet data are unchanged dense traces indexed 0 to 3999. Unknown physical axis or intensity units remain null. Do not infer spectral peak positions or silently invent units.
corpus_recipe.failure_policy: Abort rather than silently change task quotas or fill missing spectra. Report unavailable channels separately without discarding otherwise usable molecules.
